findings.quoted_text: Client may terminate for convenience upon 20 days' written notice. Contractor may not terminate for convenience. Fees for Services in progress at the effective termination date are not payable.
Upon payment of the first milestone invoice, Client owns all rights in all Deliverables, including Deliverables delivered after that payment.
The aggregate liability of either party arising from this Agreement is capped at USD 35,000, except that Contractor's indemnification obligations under Section 11 are not subject to this cap.
Client may terminate for convenience upon 20 days' written notice. Contractor may not terminate for convenience. Fees for Services in progress at the effective termination date are not payable.
findings.explanation: Only the client can terminate for convenience, and you are not paid for services in progress when they do.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon 20 days' written notice, and the Client shall pay the Contractor for all Services performed up to the effective date of termination.

findings.quoted_text: Upon payment of the first milestone invoice, Client owns all rights in all Deliverables, including Deliverables delivered after that payment.
findings.explanation: Ownership of deliverables transfers to the client after only the first milestone payment rather than upon full payment.
findings.suggested_change: Upon receipt of final payment for the Deliverables, ownership of such Deliverables shall transfer to the Client.

findings.quoted_text: The aggregate liability of either party arising from this Agreement is capped at USD 35,000, except that Contractor's indemnification obligations under Section 11 are not subject to this cap.
findings.explanation: Your indemnification obligations are excluded from the liability cap, leaving your exposure for those claims unlimited.
findings.suggested_change: The aggregate liability of either party arising from this Agreement, including any indemnification obligations, shall be capped at USD 35,000.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the agreement. I would like to propose a few minor adjustments before signing: - Regarding the termination terms, only the client can terminate for convenience and work in progress is not paid, so I propose that either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon 20 days' written notice, and the Client shall pay the Contractor for all Services performed up to the effective date of termination. - Regarding the relevant clause on deliverables, ownership currently transfers after the first milestone payment rather than final payment, so I propose that upon receipt of final payment for the Deliverables, ownership of such Deliverables shall transfer to the Client. - Regarding the limitation of liability, indemnification obligations are excluded from the cap, so I propose that the aggregate liability of either party arising from this Agreement, including any indemnification obligations, shall be capped at USD 35,000. Please let me know if these updates work for you. Best regards
